analyst.summary: AIA Engineering, the world's #2 high-chrome grinding-media maker for mining and cement, posted a strong-looking Q4 FY26 (revenue +9.4% YoY, PAT +37.9% YoY) but full-year sales volume grew only ~1% and the profit beat leaned substantially on a forex gain, treasury income and a lower tax rate rather than core operations. The stock trades at a rich ~30-35x P/E and ~25x EV/EBITDA against that soft volume trend, with FY27 growth resting on a management-guided incremental 30,000-ton ramp still 'pending trial conversions.' We rate the name Hold: balance-sheet quality and market leadership are intact, but the valuation embeds more consistent growth than FY26's underlying numbers demonstrate.
